title: Kindly Gentle Dutch Sultanas Pilaf
description: A light and comforting Dutch dish featuring sultanas, perfect for a sick day, made with sous-vide cooking and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients. This umami-rich pilaf is easy to digest and soothing to the palate.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a fine mesh strainer and drain well.
Chop the onion, garlic, carrot, and celery into small pieces.
Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the chopped vegetables until tender.
Add the sultanas, salt, and cooked basmati rice to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth and a pinch of salt.
Place the rice mixture in a sous-vide bag and pour in the broth.
Seal the bag and cook in a sous-vide water bath at 180 degrees Fahrenheit for 30 minutes.
Remove the bag from the water bath and let it cool for a few minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
